description: This file is a shell test script for testing Perforce (p4) integration, RCS keyword handling, and related functionalities within a version-controlled environment. It defines a series of automated tests to verify behaviors such as keyword scrubbing, file modifications, conflict handling, and keyword expansion, primarily focused on p4 and RCS keyword lines.

methods.name: write_scrub_scripts
methods.description: Creates Python scripts for RCS keyword scrubbing to normalize keyword lines in files.

methods.name: scrub_k_check
methods.description: Checks that the $Id$, $Revision$, and $Change$ keywords are scrubbed and the file matches expectations.

methods.name: scrub_ko_check
methods.description: Checks that only specific keywords ($Id, $Header) are scrubbed in 'ko' style files.

methods.name: create_kw_file
methods.description: Creates a sample C file with RCS keyword lines for testing.

methods.name: p4_append_to_file
methods.description: Appends a timestamp comment to a file under p4 control and submits.
